hooks.name: Session End Audit
hooks.description: End-of-session audit for consistency and commit (IDE only, skipped on spot)

action.command: bash -c '[ "$KIRO_SPOT" = "1" ] && exit 0; echo "TASK END AUDIT: 1. Check if HTML files were modified - verify nav/footer consistency across all pages. 2. Check if CSS was modified - verify for-physios and for-clinics have matching updates if needed. 3. Check if images were added - verify alt text and optimization. 4. Ask: Commit changes? (y/n). If yes, suggest a concise commit message based on the changes made."'
